findings.issue: Ask checks source revisions only before the completion request. Replacing a timeline while the provider answers still returns grounded claims and citations to the removed revision. Recheck packed evidence against fresh source artifacts before validating and returning the answer.

An uncached local SentenceTransformer raises OSError with local_files_only=True. This escapes the shared retrieval fallback, so non-strict semantic/hybrid searches fail instead of returning FTS with semantic_unavailable. Normalize model-load availability errors at the embedding boundary.

needs-human: A9 requires human-reviewed golden evidence/time ranges and semantic support evaluation, but the only replay labels are agent-authored synthetic spans and the human support rate is null. Human validation remains necessary before claiming complete issue acceptance.

summary: Fixed Ask's stale-source race and uncached local-model fallback; both regressions were red before repair and all 35 retrieval tests are green. Full offline Python validation remains non-green (630 passed, 2 WinError 87 subprocess errors, 24 skipped); the affected file passes alone, and A9 human evaluation remains needs-human. The supplied patch is empty and PR #6 returned 404, so review used the specified HEAD, its parent, and linked issue #5.
